other.starting_materials: pure Nb (99.99 wt pct), Al (99.999 wt pct), Fe (99.95 wt pct)

evidence.quote: Eleven ternary alloys with Nb contents above 60 at. pct were synthesized by arc melting from the pure metals

parameters.cooling_method: rapidly cooled inside the furnace (>100 K/min to below 1273 K (1000 °C))

evidence.quote: Heat treatments were performed at 1723 K and 1873 K (1450 °C and 1600 °C) under Ar atmosphere after triple evacuation and Ar backfilling of the furnace. ... the duration of the heat treatment was varied from 1 day (alloys 1 to 3) ...
eleven Nb-rich ternary alloys were produced from the pure metals by arc melting

Heat treatments were performed at 1723 K (1450 °C) for up to 7 days and at 1873 K (1600 °C) for up to 4 days in order to obtain well-equilibrated material. Even though the heat treatments were carried out in pure Ar atmospheres
